page.layout: Running head at top centre with page number at top right; below it a line of italic running title; then a diagram of a room with labelled corners b, c, a, d and numbered loci in five quadrants (I–V) and small numbers; below the diagram one text block of body paragraph in full width with a marginal note on the right beside the lines "Utilitas huius distinctionis".

main_text.p: quina quadrata , sed minora. e. g.

Hîc paries notatus est literis a b c d : quinque quadrata principalia notata sunt numeris I. II. III. IV. V. quinque quadrata minora notata sunt ciphris 1. 2. 3. 4. 5. &c. Utilitates è tali locorum dispositione ad nos summatim redeuntisse. I. Quodlibet conclave continebit subjecta sive loca numero centum. II. Ordo & repetitio locorum sic facilime observari potest, ita ut recenseri possint omnia ordine recto, interme-Utilitas huius distinctionis

page.notes: Diagram of a room with quadrants and corner letters b, c, a, d; the layout of numbers is reconstructed from the scan. The marginal note "Utilitas huius distinctionis" is set beside the lines. Some letters in the body are faint, notably the "s" under I and "loca", which may be misread. Page number 13 is printed at top right.
